pkgmetadata.longdescription: Strata is a local LLM inference server and toolkit: a python terminal/CLI, an HTTP API server and a C++ inference engine built for CUDA or HIP. The CUDA and HIP builds bundle the vendor GPU runtime libraries into the engine component folder, so parts of the installed files are covered by the NVIDIA-CUDA / AMD-GPU-PRO-EULA licenses in addition to Strata's own MIT license.

use.flag: Build the CUDA inference engine for NVIDIA GPUs
Build the ROCm/HIP inference engine for AMD GPUs
Build the image reader for the multimodal web UI, installed next to the engine component
Enable the textual based strata monitor TUI
